messages:
jonah_api: Quick sync — we need to decide what goes into the next streaming MVP for chat completions. SSE vs WS, delta payload shape, finish reasons, and how function/tool calling behaves when streaming. Customer asks piling up.

sara_prod: TL;DR: customers want partial outputs + resume, plus clear finish semantics. Legal teams also ask for deterministic audit logs of final vs partial. :eyes:

omar_eng: Technical constraints: browsers prefer SSE (simpler CORS), mobile/websocket multiplexing important for persistent sessions. Our runtime supports both but fallback semantics differ.

emily_research: From evals: partial deltas are very useful for interactivity, but structured output (JSON) mid-stream can be malformed until finish — consumers need guidance.

matt_mobile: Mobile apps asking for small incremental tokens to show typing indicator. They also want to cancel and resume without re-running entire prompt (resume by offset or prefix cache).

jonah_api: Proposed MVP scope (narrow): 1) Support SSE + WS transports; 2) Send token deltas as the default; 3) Emit a deterministic finish event with reason codes; 4) Provide a resume token header for clients to request continuation from same model state. Anything dangerously large here?

omar_eng: Resume token is tricky — requires KV-caching per-request and retention. Ops cost increases. Alternative: allow prefix/KV snapshot export but mark as enterprise-only.

sara_prod: Customers in enterprise pilots need resume for long-running assistants. Could gate resume behind Dedicated/Private and explicit retention TTL. Launch criteria: must work for 95% of in-flight requests during canary.

emily_research: Finish reason taxonomy proposal (short list): `completed`, `stopped_by_user`, `model_error`, `truncated_by_length`, `fallback_to_sync`. Each as `finish_reason` in final delta. Keep minimal.

jonah_api: Agree on minimal finish reasons. Need contract for mid-stream structured output: deltas can contain `text_delta` OR `json_delta` OR `tool_call_delta`. Clients should be told those may be incomplete. Suggest `delta.partial = true|false` and final delta sets `partial=false` and includes `finish_reason`.

matt_mobile: For mobile UX, partial=true for text deltas is ok. But if `json_delta.partial=true`, we should avoid attempting to parse until final. Add a `json_schema_version` and `json_checksum` on final? :+1:

omar_eng: Implementation notes: Websocket path will be `/v1/streams/ws` with binary frames allowed; SSE path `/v1/streams/sse`. Handshake includes `client_capabilities` (resume, multiplexing). If `resume` not supported by infra tier, server returns `Resume-Unavailable` header in handshake.

jonah_api: Backwards compatibility: existing non-streaming endpoints remain. SDKs should add `onDelta` callback and `onFinish` with `(finish_reason)` param. Docs must show examples.

emily_research: Customer-driven ask: function/tool calling mid-stream. We can stream token deltas while the model emits a `tool_call_delta` indicating name + partial args. Real ask: allow client to accept partial tool call and invoke external tool before finish. That's a bigger contract and likely out of MVP.

sara_prod: Proposed priority: MVP1 = streaming tokens + finish_reason + SSE/WS with clear handshake + enterprise resume flagged. MVP2 = streaming structured/tool deltas with safe parse guidance + resume for self-serve.

omar_eng: Launch gates: tests for resume failure modes, rate-limited KV usage, TLS/handshake for SSE proxies, mobile offline reconnection behavior. Canary on 1% of traffic, then 10%. Rollback path to non-streaming sync responses if errors > 1% of canary.

matt_mobile: UX checklist: typing indicator latency <150ms for first token; client reconnection tries exponential backoff and requests resume token; fallback to full sync if resume fails.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: canary/streams/mvp1 -> 10 servers, 2024-11-07T15:18:00Z

jonah_api: Action items: 1) eng: draft handshake + delta schema (omar) 2) docs: example SDK patterns + UX caveats (sara) 3) research: evaluate partial-json parsing safety heuristics (emily) 4) product: finalize MVP gating and enterprise resume policy (me). Target: 3-week sprint.

sara_prod: Sounds good. I'll collate the customer asks and mark resume as enterprise-gated for launch. :thumbsup:

omar_eng: I'll put up PR with proto sketches and perf estimates by EOD tomorrow.

emily_research: I'll run tests on partial JSON streaming with noisy tokenization and report edge cases.

jonah_api: Thanks all — we'll sync Thurs if PRs land.
